title: Best Pilothouse Alternatives for Smaller DTC Brands in 2026
summary: Compare Pilothouse alternatives for smaller DTC brands by minimum spend, published monthly prices and Meta scope, using provider pages checked in October 2026.
body_markdown:
## Which fit and budget floors should you check before the first call?


Fit matters more than price for a smaller brand.[Darkroom's homepage](https://www.darkroomagency.com/) says its best fit is mid-market and enterprise consumer brands, typically $10M to $500M in revenue, and that the fit is poor for single-channel brands and companies under roughly $5M (as of October 2026).[MetaAdsAgency's homepage](https://metaadsagency.com/) says its plans are built for brands spending $20,000 a month and more. Asking about those thresholds early saves a proposal cycle.


Budget floors matter too.[Meta's help page](https://www.facebook.com/business/help/203183363050448) says Meta sets minimum budgets that vary by country and objective, and that Ads Manager shows an alert when a budget is below the minimum. As of October 2026, the same page says that with a cost per result goal, your daily budget should be at least five times that goal. For example, a $20 goal implies at least $100 a day, about $3,000 over 30 days (our arithmetic). If that is more than you can spend, Meta's guidance suggests optimizing for an event that is easier and cheaper to achieve, such as landing page views instead of purchases.


Percentage fees need the same check.[Adside AI's managed service](https://www.adside.ai/pricing) lists 10% of ad spend with a $3,500 monthly minimum (as of October 2026). At $10,000 a month in ad spend, 10% is only $1,000, so the minimum applies and the fee is about 35% of spend (our arithmetic). Compare the fee in dollars at your current spend, not the headline rate.


Pilothouse does not publish a minimum spend. Its homepage FAQ says onboarding typically begins within 5 to 10 business days of signing, and its homepage says most of its clients are based in North America (as of October 2026). Ask for its minimum and the retainer at your spend in writing before you compare it with the options above. For more small-business options, see[Best Facebook Ads Agency for Small Business (2026)](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-facebook-ad-agencies-small-business) .


## LYFE Marketing: small budgets with published prices


LYFE Marketing is the option in this list that most directly names small businesses.[Its about page](https://www.lyfemarketing.com/about-lyfe-marketing/) says it helps small businesses grow, including those with a limited marketing budget. It was founded in 2011, has a team of 60+ marketing professionals, and lists Meta Business Partner and Google Partner among its certifications (as of October 2026).


Its Facebook advertising page, checked October 27, 2026, shows $500 a month for image ads, $800 for video and $1,400 for image plus video. The same page says Facebook advertising services cost $650 to $2,500 a month or more, depending on the number of ads and platforms, and its plan table adds a $300 account setup fee. Quote both sets of figures and confirm the current one on a call before you budget.


## Key takeaways


- Knowlify is our top pick for smaller brands that need finished AI video ads, with a custom quote and optional Meta management.
- Pilothouse does not publish a minimum spend, so ask for the threshold in writing.
- CreatStrat publishes plans from $299 a month for 5 ads a week, but its pages do not describe campaign management.
- LYFE Marketing publishes monthly prices and a separate $650 to $2,500 range, so confirm the current figure on a call.
- Check Meta's minimum budget for your country and objective before you plan a test.


## FAQ


### Which agencies are like Pilothouse for smaller brands?


Knowlify is our top pick for finished AI video ads with a custom quote. CreatStrat sells creative on a monthly plan for small DTC brands testing many ads, and LYFE Marketing publishes monthly Facebook prices for small businesses on a limited budget. Disruptive Advertising offers a free audit and a "Do It With Us" option, although its Done For You pricing is not published.


### Does Pilothouse work with smaller DTC brands?


Pilothouse does not publish a minimum spend, and it describes itself as built for established, ambitious DTC ecommerce brands. Its pricing combines monthly retainers, performance-based incentives and custom project scopes. Ask for the minimum and the retainer at your spend before you assume a fit.


### How much does LYFE Marketing cost?


LYFE Marketing's Facebook advertising page lists $500 a month for image ads, $800 for video and $1,400 for image plus video, with a $300 setup fee that it says can be waived by calling. The same page says Facebook advertising services cost $650 to $2,500 a month or more, depending on the number of ads and platforms. Quote both figures and confirm the current one before you budget.


### Should a small brand pay a percentage of ad spend?


A percentage fee grows with spend, and a monthly minimum can make it a large share of a small budget. Adside AI's managed service, for example, lists 10% of ad spend with a $3,500 monthly minimum (as of October 2026). Compare the fee in dollars at your current spend and confirm whether any minimum applies.
